now.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
now.text: Titania turns up at the Intelligencia summit to fight Jen and is arrested.

proposed.text: Titania crashes the Intelligencia event at Emil's retreat, then films Todd's arrest for her fans and greets Daredevil.

changes.evidence: In episode 9 Titania blasts into the Intelligencia event at Summer Twilights, but she is not arrested: the police take Todd Phelps (and Blonsky) into custody while Titania films the showdown for her fans and then greets Daredevil. F3: she is left free, so not In custody.

now.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
now.text: Jiang Li leaves Ta Lo to marry Wenwu, and is killed by the Iron Gang while he is away.

proposed.text: Ying Li leaves Ta Lo to marry Wenwu, and is killed by the Iron Gang while he is away.

changes.evidence: The film names Shang-Chi's mother Ying Li (credits and plot; the Ying Li name also appears in this index's own pendant file). 'Jiang Li' was only the name in Marvel's December 2020 cast announcement and merchandise, and is the comics name. The rest of the record is correct.

now.title: She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
now.text: In episode 7, Saracen joins Emil's group therapy and tells Jen that Josh just wanted her blood.

proposed.text: In episode 7, Saracen joins Emil's group therapy, where he offers to suck the blood of Josh, the man who stopped texting Jen.

changes.evidence: In episode 7's group therapy the group helps Jen get over Josh, and Saracen says he wants to suck Josh's blood. Nobody at the retreat tells Jen that Josh wanted her blood; that theft is shown only to the viewer in the episode's final scene.

now.title: The Daily Bugle
now.text: In episode 25, Jameson talks over his new intern Betty Brant when she defends Peter, and keeps calling him the Spider-Menace.

proposed.text: In episode 8, Jameson talks over his new intern Betty Brant when she defends Peter, and keeps calling him the Spider-Menace.

changes.evidence: Betty defending Peter and being cut off by Jameson's rant is the second TikTok video ('Tell us you hate Spider-Man without telling us...'). In this index's episode list for The Daily Bugle (season 1 = 6 YouTube videos, season 2 = 13 TikToks then 6 YouTube videos) that is episode 8 of the show. Episode 25 is 'The Spider-Menace Strikes Again!', a YouTube video without Betty. The same numbering puts Ned's interview (TikTok #8) at episode 14, which matches the Ned file.

owner_calls.question: The file's name (and key) is 'Jiang Li', but the film calls her Ying Li. Should the file be renamed?
owner_calls.evidence: Wikipedia and the MCU wiki give Ying Li as the on-screen name. Jiang Li was the name in the 2020 cast announcement and is the comics name. C:li-pendants already says 'Ying Li's pendants'.

owner_calls.question: The file's kind says 'Shaun and Katy's friend', but Jon Jon only meets them in Macau. He is the ringmaster at Xialing's fight club (as the record says). Should the kind change?
options: Change kind to 'The ringmaster of Xialing's Macau fight club'
owner_calls.evidence: Jon Jon is the ringmaster at the Golden Daggers Club, hired by Xialing. He first meets Shang-Chi and Katy when they come looking for her, and he later joins her Ten Rings.
